description: Every WearableDocs price: the yearly subscription for the first person and for each additional person on a household plan, and the one-time cost of each wearable and of the printed wallet card. Figures are US cents and dollars, and are what the checkout actually charges. Only settled prices appear here — never quote a price for anything this tool does not return, and never infer one from a product name.
